name: State Wire & Terminal, Inc.
old_description: We’ve been saving our customers’ time, energy, and helping their bottom lines since 1973. We get you the parts you need fast and working with an industry leader like us couldn’t be easier. Based outside of Detroit, Michigan, we distribute electrical components for maintenance and repair applications in a variety of industries across the United States. We offer over 100,000 quality parts from industry-leading manufacturers like 3M, Deutsch, Hellerman Tyton, and Pollak with 12,000+ products available for same-day shipping. Working with us is simple: we manage your inventory and replacement component needs, so you can get back to managing your business. Our inventory management system anticipates your company’s needs and helps ensure you never run out of critical parts. And when you do need to restock, our knowledgeable and friendly customer service staff is there to help!
about:
State Wire & Terminal, Inc. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, just outside Detroit. The company began as a distributor of electrical components for maintenance and repair applications.

The company distributes electrical components for maintenance and repair across various industries, stocking over 100,000 parts from manufacturers such as 3M, Deutsch, HellermannTyton, and Pollak. More than 12,000 items are available for same-day shipping. In addition to electrical components, State Wire & Terminal offers a line of storage solutions including component kit boxes, bearing racks, bins, and wire spool racks. An inventory management system helps customers anticipate needs and avoid stockouts, and a Will Call counter at the Auburn Hills facility allows for immediate pickup of hundreds of items.

State Wire & Terminal serves a broad range of motor-powered industries. Its customer base includes utilities (electric, gas, water and sewage), recreational vehicle manufacturers, construction firms, trucking operations, government and municipal agencies, and marine applications. The company also supplies hospitals, HVAC contractors, schools, farms, and other motorized industries.

The company emphasizes saving customers time and money through fast parts delivery and inventory management. Its system anticipates demand to prevent stockouts, and customer service staff assist with restocking. Same-day shipping on thousands of items and a Will Call counter for immediate pickup further differentiate the service.
